jamie: EOD check-in: pipeline + blockers

jamie: Quick pipeline update: Cortexa Health (P50) - legal review pending; Nimbus Retail (P30) - demo tomorrow slot confirmed.
jamie: Blockers: Cortexa sent an enterprise security questionnaire. They want KMS/HSM details, VPC peering steps, audit log retention policy, SOC2 evidence, and on-prem lead times. Customer is leaning private deployment.
jamie: Can eng/security/SRE chime in with short answers and lead-time estimates? Need a blurb we can paste into email before 5pm PT.

alex: I can draft the blurb. Short answer for buyers: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault), VPC peering for Private mode, and an on-prem installer for air-gapped envs.
alex: Typical timelines: VPC/private VPC deploy ~1-2 weeks (networking-dependent); on-prem ~4-6 weeks for install + validation. I'll draft a 3-4 line summary.

alex: Example config snippet I share with buyers:
```
private_deploy:
  enable_customer_kms: true
  kms_providers:
    - aws_kms: "arn:aws:kms:..."
```

sanjay: @jamie drop the questionnaire here and I'll map answers. High-priority asks: encryption at rest, KMS key rotation & access controls, HSM support path, audit log retention (they asked for >=1 year), penetration test reports, PCI/PHI handling.
sanjay: SOC2 report is available: https://redwood.com/compliance/soc2-2024.pdf
sanjay: For hosted BYOK we use cloud KMS; for private we can integrate with customer HSMs via our partner flow (details in private docs).

maria: Demo confirmed for Nimbus tomorrow 11:30am PT. I'll need a short latency artifact (median/95th) for the model we plan to show.

alex: Uploading perf snapshot from our recent runs, will paste link here once available.

eng-bot: Performance snapshot uploaded: https://redwood.com/internal/perf/cortexa-2026-03-16.png

jamie: Awesome thanks. @sanjay @alex can you each add 1-2 lines (security blurb + timeline) in this thread? I want to paste them into the buyer email by 5pm PT. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: I'll prep the email template.

jamie: Customer questionnaire (link): https://drive.google.com/xyz
jamie: End of thread.
